component.name: Pin
component.summary: Keep your ranked priorities on top of every window

description.p: Pin is a small priority note that stays above your other windows. Each line is a task: drag it up or down to rank it, color it, give it subtasks and a date, and tick it off.

ul.li: Twelve colors plus any custom color
Subtasks with one click or Ctrl+T, dates with Ctrl+D
Undo and redo for every change
Unpin it with one click when you need the space
Your list is a plain Markdown file in your Documents folder, readable by any notes app

screenshot.caption: Ranked, colored tasks with subtasks and dates

description.p: Stays on top under Wayland desktops; first Flathub release.
